evidence_items.explanation: GPT-3.5 failed variants of tasks about what people could see and believe. This supports fragile psychological reasoning, although the author also identifies scene understanding and other reasoning failures as possible explanations.

GPT-4 performed well on classic false-belief tasks. This materially challenges a claim of no psychological competence whatsoever, but does not establish robust performance across variations or competence in mental-health advice.
